title: Young Nebraska Scientists High School Researchers
pay_text: $15/hour for 20-40 hours per week for up to 8 weeks
who_text: Nebraska residents who are at least 16 and in 10th or 11th grade
description: A paid summer job working on a real university research team in Lincoln. You work from early June to early August and need teacher recommendations to apply. Applications open in early spring and spots are very limited, and there is no housing, so you need to commute.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
who_text: College freshmen, sophomores and juniors who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents, usually with a GPA of 3.2 or higher
description: A 10 week, full time summer research job in a medical science lab in Omaha. You get a stipend and go to weekly seminars about research careers. Applications for summer 2027 open November 1, 2026.
